messages:
Maya: quick note 4 — Sam's birthday is next Thursday (7/18). thinking a low-key surprise: desk decorations + small potted plant. anyone want to help decorate at 10:30am? :tada:
Leo: yes please! I can bring crepe streamers and a tiny banner. what floor is Sam on again?
Olivia: third floor, desk by the window. I can do a small plant from the plant shop nearby 33f budget ~$20?
Noah: count me in at 10:15 to help set up. can someone grab a card?
Maya: thanks! I'll buy a card and some confetti poppers (low confetti please 605). budget: let's keep it under $30 total.
Leo: poll: 1) plant + decorations 2) cupcakes + decorations 3) plant + card only. Reply with 1/2/3.
Olivia: 1
Noah: 1
Leo: votes so far: 1 (Olivia, Noah).
Maya: CalendarBot, create an event for surprise decoration 10:15am Thu Jul 18 with "Do not invite Sam" note :sweat_smile:
CalendarBot: Event created: "Surprise: Sam's Bday Setup" 10:15 AM Thu Jul 18 Conference Room B for staging. Private invite to participants.
Noah: also can we do a tiny surprise Zoom for remote teammates at 11am PT? 5-10 minutes.
Olivia: yes remote folks would appreciate that. Maya can you add a quick Zoom link?
Maya: added Zoom and reminder in the event. I'll DM @Remote-Eng list to coordinate.
Leo: I'll pick up a small succulent and a "congrats" cupcake box from Baker's Corner. leaving it on Sam's desk at 10:25.
Olivia: I'll get the card and ask folks to sign. DM me if you want to chip in for a $5 group gift.
Noah: left a :thumbsup: reaction on the event.
Maya: final plan: decorate 10:15, leave gift + card, quick virtual wave at 11am PT. budget under $30. thanks all! :balloon:
Leo: dropping a cute gif in thread: https://giphy.com/gifs/birthday-cute-3o6ZsXQW1D5xO4y2aY
Olivia: hearts! :heartpulse: see you Thursday.
Maya: sweet 382 thanks team, and reminder to meet at the lobby at 10:10 if you're coming in early.
